title: Origin story: Mirelurk
description: Mirelurk is the spirit of the great bog, which preserves what it takes — the bog bodies sleep undecayed for millennia. She keeps the drowned histories, the lost roads, the buried offerings, and she gives them back when the time is right: a sword for the heir, a road for the lost, a truth for the seeker.
